scope: owned temporary files and child processes only; no product service/backend/guest

observations.flock_dup: lock survived until last duplicate of the locked description closed
observations.flock_independent: independent open contended; closing an unlocked independent descriptor did not release owner
observations.ofd_description: lock survived dup and unrelated closes, then released on last duplicate close
observations.record_same_process: a second open joined the process lock; closing it released all record locks on the file

observations.flock_exec_cloexec: CLOEXEC released lock at exec; non-CLOEXEC retained it
observations.flock_fork: fork-only child retained the same open file description and lock
observations.ofd_fork_exec: fork retained the description; CLOEXEC released at exec and non-CLOEXEC retained it
observations.record_exec: POSIX record lock survived same-process exec unless CLOEXEC closed its descriptor
observations.record_fork: POSIX record lock was not inherited across fork

observations.flock: cross-process contention and process-death release observed
observations.ofd: cross-process contention and process-death release observed
observations.posix_record: cross-process contention and process-death release observed

observations.renamed_original: held flock stayed with the original inode
observations.replacement: new pathname inode could be locked concurrently
observations.unlinked_open_object: lock remained descriptor-scoped until close, while pathname was absent

observations.duplicate: busy before store read, recovery enumeration, mutation, or adapter marker
observations.process_death: SIGKILL closed last owner descriptor; successor acquired

observations.accepted: pre-created mode-0600 regular file with exact uid/dev/inode/nlink
observations.actual_cross_uid_chown: not run; no root or second-user authority used
observations.retained_directory_fd: openat remained bound to original directory after path replacement
